q23.

The memo entity is defined once per layer:

- SQL schema: `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql` (also mirrored per dialect in `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql` and `store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql` — the `memo` table exists in all three)
- Go store model: `store/memo.go` (the `Memo` struct)
- API proto message: `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` (`message Memo` at line 198; the generated Go binding lives in `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.go`)
- Generated frontend types: `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`
